Start: Changeling Berserker (hand); Dual Nature (battlefield)

  When Changeling Berserker enters the battlefield, its champion ability and Dual Nature's first ability trigger.

  Repeat from step 2.
  If you control additional creatures you wish to blink, you may resolve the Changeling Berserker trigger in step 2 to exile them, and then proceed with the combo.

## Combo 248-1916-4846
Cards: Worldgorger Dragon + Changeling Berserker + Changeling Titan
Color identity: RG | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 16 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
Produces: Infinite mana lands you control can produce; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite blinking of permanents
Start: Worldgorger Dragon (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Changeling Berserker (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Changeling Titan (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield)
Prerequisites: Changeling Titan must be exiled by Changeling Berserker, and Worldgorger Dragon must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
Steps: Cast Worldgorger Dragon for its mana cost.
  When Worldgorger Dragon enters, it exiles Changeling Berserker until Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Worldgorger Dragon's ETB.
  When Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield, Changeling Titan is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Changeling Titan enters, it exiles Worldgorger Dragon until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Titan's ETB.
  When Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, Changeling Berserker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Changeling Berserker enters, it exiles Changeling Titan until Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Berserker's ETB.
  When Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, Worldgorger Dragon is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).

Color identity: RG | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 19 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite combat phases; Infinite combat damage; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature ETB; Near-infinite landfall triggers; Put all basic lands from your library onto the battlefield
Start: Sword of Hearth and Home (battlefield); Combat Celebrant (battlefield); Fires of Yavimaya (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Sword of Hearth and Home attached to any creature you control except Combat Celebrant.
  An opponent is unable to block Combat Celebrant or the creature with Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
  You have not exerted Combat Celebrant this turn.
Steps: Declare the creature with Sword of Hearth and Home and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
  Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
  Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
  Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, exiling Combat Celebrant, then causing you to search your library for a basic land card, then put the land and Combat Celebrant onto the battlefield.
  Repeat each combat phase.

  Repeat each combat phase.
